description: This header file defines structures, macros, and functions for handling custom classes in PyTorch, including registration, schema management, and utility functions related to custom C++ classes within the torch namespace.

classes.name: arg
classes.description: Represents default argument values for registering methods of custom classes.

classes.name: detail::class_base
classes.description: Base class providing registration and schema utilities for custom classes.

methods.name: record_custom_class
methods.description: Records a custom class load event, used internally when macro is enabled.

methods.name: arg::none
methods.description: Returns an IValue representing a None default argument.

methods.name: arg::arg
methods.description: Constructor for creating an argument with a name.

methods.name: arg::operator=
methods.description: Assigns a default value to the argument.
